addition.item: New Mapy.com map type with custom settings, completely independent of OpenStreetMap.
Mapy.com configuration options split into free and paid API services.
Scroll/gesture protection for embedded Mapy.com maps to prevent accidental panning.
Marker tags: management, filtering, and selection in menu items and the content plugin.
Font Awesome icon picker with a live marker preview.
"Control Panel" (Dashboard) button across all admin list views.
